messages:
emma: Kicking off the late window in ~7m (22:45 UTC). Objective: coordinated push across API (4.2->4.3), Console schema change S-M8, Runtime small bump to 3.3, and a router header-split toggle. Sequence proposed: small API canary -> console schema apply -> runtime canary -> router header-swap with soft-pin. Need calls on pin durations + concrete rollback triggers.
Carlos: Quick Q  how long is the schema apply for S-M8? Any blocking writes?
Priya: Schema apply will require a 2-min read-only quiesce for console write paths, only affects /console-admin endpoints. Low traffic window but still gotta warn customers.
vlad: For router header swap, we should soft-pin to the previous version for 6h to give ops time to roll back if header routing misbehaves. Suggest router pin 3.0.2 -> 3.0.3 with 6h duration.
deploy-bot: preflight initiated: release id rc-2025-06-31
deploy-bot: preflight summary: api: ok, console: minor warning (schema delta compatible but requires quiesce), runtime: ok, router: ok, infra: warning - ephemeral pool fragmentation on us-east-1.
infra-bot: note: ephemeral fragmentation may cause a few cold-start evictions under burst. Auto-scale margin currently +15%.
Carlos: Given fragmentation, canary pct should be 1% not 3%. Also add 3m stabilization window between each stage.
Priya: +1 to Carlos. We should also enable a traffic mirror for runtime canary to validate logs without sending errors to users.
emma: ok set canary to 1% for API, 3m stabilize between stages, runtime mirror enabled. What about automatic rollback thresholds?
vlad: Propose rollback if error-rate > 3% sustained for 4m OR p95 latency increases > 300ms vs baseline for 3m. For header-swap specifically, fail if routing mismatch rate > 0.2% over 5m.
deploy-bot: rollout plan created: api@4.3 canary 1% (stagger 3m) -> console S-M8 quiesce (2m) -> runtime@3.3 canary (mirror enabled) -> router header-swap toggle + pin 3.0.3 for 6h. plan id: plan-8892
Carlos: Add CLI snippet for ops audit:
```
# pin router during header-swap
deployctl pin --service router --version 3.0.3 --duration 6h --reason "header-split toggle S-M8"
# start api small canary
deployctl rollout --service api --version 4.3 --strategy canary --percent 1 --stagger 3m
```
Priya: Ops note: will post a short customer advisory about the 2-min console quiesce. I'll draft and link docs PR.
infra-bot: autoscale margin increased to +25% for us-east-1 for this window.
emma: Nice. Ops owners: can we have a rapid manual rollback play if header-swap mismatch > 0.2% ? Priya, can you own that?
Priya: I can own the header rollback. I'll be on standby and will trigger pin rollback and header toggle revert if threshold hit.
vlad: Also add a soft-traffic-cut throttle rule: if pool CPU > 85% reduce new sessions by 30% for 10m. Saves us from more evictions.
em ma: (typo) Emma: noted and added to playbook.
deploy-bot: api canary started api@4.3 (1%) id: cb-8893
deploy-bot: monitor: api errors 0.1% | p95 +15ms | mirror traffic to runtime-canary enabled
Carlos: Monitoring dashboard link: https://dash.internal/redwood/releases/plan-8892 (watch p95, errors, routing mismatch metric)
Priya: Draft PR for release notes: https://git.internal.redwood/docs/pull/5009 includes admin quiesce line and header-swap note.
emma: Decision summary: 1) API canary 1% staggered 3m; 2) Console quiesce 2m during migration; 3) Runtime canary mirrored; 4) Router header-swap toggle with pin to 3.0.3 for 6h; 5) Autoscale margin +25% us-east and soft-throttle rule if CPU >85%; 6) rollback thresholds: api/runtime errors >3% for 4m or p95 +300ms for 3m; header mismatch >0.2% for 5m -> immediate revert.
Carlos: +1
Priya: +1, oncall ready
vlad: +1
emma: executing pin and kicking console quiesce in 4m. If anything anomalous, call rollback and ping #incidents. I'll update thread when console apply completes.
deploy-bot: router pin created: router@3.0.3 until +6h (action id: pin-8899) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: next: console quiesce scheduled in 4m. runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/console-s-m8
emma: thanks team. Leaving this thread open for post-migration status updates.
